## Christian Riveros

Researcher and author of MeteoAndes. Research lines include glacier remote sensing, InSAR, ICESat‑2, high-mountain meteorology, aerosols and black carbon.

Collaborator names, affiliations and contributions will be incorporated with authorization and CRediT roles in each product.
